title: Bella Arrives in Forks
text: What if falling in love meant giving up your human life forever? Our story begins when Bella Swan moves to the rainy town of Forks, Washington. But she has no idea what's waiting for her.

title: Bella Meets Edward
text: At her new school, Bella meets the mysterious Edward Cullen. He's handsome, strangely pale, and seems determined to avoid her. But Edward is hiding something terrifying.

title: Edward Saves Bella
text: One day, a van loses control and nearly crushes Bella. Edward suddenly appears and stops it with his bare hands. No ordinary human could move that fast.

title: Edward's Secret
text: Bella discovers the truth. Edward is a vampire! But unlike other vampires, his family refuses to hunt humans. Even stranger, Edward can read minds — except Bella's.

title: James Hunts Bella
text: Their romance quickly becomes dangerous when James, a ruthless vampire tracker, begins hunting Bella. Edward saves her, but Bella realizes loving him could cost her life.

title: Edward Leaves Bella
text: In New Moon, Edward leaves Bella, believing she's safer without him. Heartbroken, Bella struggles to move forward. But another supernatural secret is about to change everything.

title: Bella Gets Close to Jacob
text: Bella grows closer to her childhood friend Jacob Black. He helps her recover from Edward's disappearance, and their friendship grows stronger. But Jacob has a dangerous secret of his own.

title: Jacob Becomes a Werewolf
text: Jacob transforms into a giant wolf! His pack protects humans from vampires. Bella now finds herself caught between two supernatural worlds — and two people who love her.

title: Edward Thinks Bella Is Dead
text: After a terrible misunderstanding, Edward believes Bella has died. Unable to face eternity without her, he travels to Italy, hoping the powerful Volturi will end his life.

title: The Volturi Appear
text: Bella rushes to Italy and saves Edward. But the Volturi, ancient rulers of the vampire world, discover Bella knows their secret. Now her future hangs in the balance.

title: Victoria Builds an Army
text: In Eclipse, Victoria creates an army of newborn vampires to destroy Bella and avenge James. The Cullens and Jacob's wolf pack must work together to protect her.

title: Bella Chooses Edward
text: Despite her strong bond with Jacob, Bella chooses Edward. She decides she wants to spend eternity with him, even if that means leaving her human life behind.

title: Bella and Edward Get Married
text: In Breaking Dawn, Bella and Edward finally marry. But their happiness doesn't last long. Bella becomes pregnant with a half-human, half-vampire child, and the pregnancy threatens her life.

title: Renesmee Is Born
text: Bella gives birth to Renesmee, but nearly dies. Edward transforms her into a vampire to save her. And here's the twist — Bella develops an extraordinary power: a mental shield.

title: The Volturi Confront the Cullens
text: The Volturi believe Renesmee is a forbidden immortal child and arrive to destroy the Cullens. But Alice brings another human-vampire hybrid as proof that Renesmee isn't a threat.

title: Bella's Shield and the Real Ending
text: Bella uses her shield to protect her family from the Volturi's mental powers. And here's the biggest twist: unlike the movie, the final battle never happens in the book! The Volturi retreat without fighting.

title: The Final Clue
text: Remember how Edward could never read Bella's thoughts? That was the first clue to her shield ability all along. And at the end, Bella finally lets Edward see inside her mind.

title: Plot Twist with RG
text: So Twilight was never just about choosing between Edward and Jacob. It was about Bella discovering her true power. Which plot twist surprised you most? Subscribe to Plot Twist with RG for more book breakdowns!
